message.content:
The cost of renting an apartment in New York City varies widely depending on the borough, neighborhood, size, and building amenities. As a rough guide:

| Borough | Typical rent for a 1‑bedroom (average) |
|---------|----------------------------------------|
| Manhattan | $3,200 – $4,500 per month |
| Brooklyn | $2,400 – $3,800 per month |
| Queens | $1,800 – $3,000 per month |
| Bronx | $1,500 – $2,500 per month |
| Staten Island | $1,300 – $2,200 per month |

These figures are averages for mid‑range apartments; luxury units or newly built developments can command higher prices, while older or smaller units may be cheaper. For a more precise estimate, let me know the specific borough, neighborhood, and apartment size you’re interested in.
